display.purpose: Today、登录和页面主标题的单一 sans-serif 层级。

headline.purpose: 当前 Completion Item、休息计时和重要执行上下文。

title.purpose: 卡片、训练模块和页面分区标题。

body.purpose: 说明、处方和历史趋势内容。

label.purpose: 按钮、状态、导航和元数据。

shadows.name: content-ambient
shadows.purpose: Established content cards such as Today plan, focus card, calendar detail and summary card.

shadows.name: selected-state
shadows.purpose: Short-lived emphasis for selected or hovered calendar states.

shadows.name: subtle-control
shadows.purpose: Selected tabs and small active controls.

motion.name: loading-spin
motion.purpose: Existing loading spinner only; future state motion should remain brief and respect reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action for starting, completing or confirming a training workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; padding: 13px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; font: 720 12px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(214, 93, 63, .35); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: .88; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action that keeps the primary training path visually dominant.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); padding: 13px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; font: 720 12px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: rgba(214, 93, 63, .04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(214, 93, 63, .3); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: rgba(214, 93, 63, .08); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A calm, legible field for actual values, feedback and plan input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink); font: 720 12px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; font: 400 16px/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid rgba(214, 93, 63, .2); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: A quiet surface for plan context, summaries and supporting training information.
components.html:
今日训练

3 个模块 · 约 32 分钟
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(74, 52, 30, .08); } .ds-card p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 16px/1.6 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A compact semantic state label for completed, rest or attention states.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #eee4d7; color: var(--green); font: 720 12px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(71, 122, 93, .28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: The mobile-first global navigation for Today, Calendar, Progress and Settings.
components.html: <nav class="ds-bottom-nav"><button class="ds-nav-link is-active">今日</button><button class="ds-nav-link">日历</button><button class="ds-nav-link">进展</button><button class="ds-nav-link">设置</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0; padding: 14px 14px 18px; background: rgba(255, 253, 248, .94); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); backdrop-filter: blur(15px); } .ds-nav-link { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 3px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font: 400 14px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--accent-dark); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(214, 93, 63, .25); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: var(--accent-dark); font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Focus Execution Stage
components.description: The signature one-item-at-a-time surface for executing a Workout Session.
components.html:
1 / 6 · 训练

侧平板

计划：40 秒 · 休息 30 秒
components.css: .ds-focus-stage { display: flex; min-height: 420px; flex-direction: column; padding: 24px 18px 94px; background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); } .ds-focus-count { align-self: flex-start; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f2e5d9; color: var(--accent-dark); font: 720 12px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-focus-stage h2 { margin: 16px 0 8px; font: 700 30px/1.1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; } .ds-focus-prescription { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-wide { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; margin-top: auto; }

components.name: Rest Screen
components.description: A focused recovery state that keeps the next item visible and the skip action clear.
components.html:
组间休息

放松，准备下一项

00:30
components.css: .ds-rest-screen { display: flex; min-height: 420px; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 28px 20px 94px; background: var(--card); color: var(--ink); text-align: center; } .ds-rest-label { align-self: center; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e8f0e8; color: var(--green); font: 720 11px/1.3 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rest-screen h2 { margin: 16px 0 0; font: 700 22px/1.2 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rest-time { margin-top: 24px; color: var(--ink); font: 520 60px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-rest-screen .ds-btn-secondary { align-self: center; min-width: 160px; margin-top: 34px; }

narrative.overview:
Workout Tracker 的界面应该像一个在训练间隙仍然安静可靠的工作台：信息被整理到手边，主要动作一眼可见，状态不会藏在装饰里。它服务于 Athlete 当下的执行，也为训练结束后的历史和趋势保留清楚、可修正的记录边界。

整体采用克制的产品型视觉语言：纸张般的浅色内容面、柔和陶土橙的行动色、恢复绿的完成状态，以及单一 sans-serif 字体系统。层次来自留白、细边界和轻柔的环境抬升，而不是游戏化徽章、排行榜、强刺激动效或过多装饰。
keyCharacteristics: 安静、专注的训练执行面
清晰的大号数字和明确的状态反馈
柔和陶土橙只承担行动和选择
恢复绿承担完成、恢复和积极状态
移动端优先、触控区域宽松、内容不被固定底栏遮挡

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: 陶土橙只用于行动、选择、进度和需要注意的状态；不把主色铺满背景，也不把颜色当作装饰。

rules.name: The One Sans Rule
rules.body: 不为单个新页面引入第二套相似 sans-serif；通过字重、尺寸和间距表达层级，保留产品的熟悉感。

rules.name: The Quiet Lift Rule
rules.body: 表面默认依靠色调和细线分层；只有已有的内容卡片、选中状态和固定底栏使用阴影或 blur，新增组件不叠加更重的装饰性层次。

dos: Do use the existing accent, neutral and semantic status tokens before adding a new color.
Do keep the main action obvious, wide and reachable on a phone; preserve 44px navigation targets and 48px focus actions.
Do make timer values, actual values and completion states legible without requiring audio.
Do use pending, disabled, error, paused and resumed states that retain the existing button, card, notice and spacing vocabulary.
Do preserve the quiet relationship between Training Plan Snapshot, Workout Session and Actual Training Data in both copy and visual hierarchy.
donts: Don't make this an over-gamified, noisy fitness app that relies on badges or leaderboards.
Don't add a second visual language for timed actions, audio controls or Wake Lock; extend the focus execution surface.
Don't use decorative gradients, default glassmorphism, colored side-stripe borders or oversized shadow-plus-border treatments on new components.
Don't tighten display letter-spacing beyond -0.04em or let large headings overflow a mobile viewport.
Don't make sound the only way to understand a timer, status, error or saved result.
